findings.summary: Strict line parsing rejects schema-valid integral JSON numbers
findings.suggestion: Normalize finite integral numeric line values before strict validation; reject bool, strings and fractions.

reasoning.observe: Strict int field conflicts with draft-07 integer|null schema and SPEC S4.
reasoning.conclude: Parser violates AC-004 independent of deferred integration.

findings.summary: Malformed success markers can become clean opinions without failing parser tests
findings.suggestion: Exercise absent and contradictory success/error markers with otherwise valid payloads.

reasoning.observe: All valid fixtures set both success markers; the failure fixture sets both failure markers.
reasoning.trace: Removing the ambiguous-success guard leaves 15 parser tests green.
reasoning.infer: Missing is_error could be accepted undetected.
reasoning.conclude: AC-005 discrimination needs independent marker cases.
